visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a man with short brown hair wearing a black t-shirt. He stands in a brightly lit retail environment, specifically a high-end beauty counter. He holds a black RODE microphone in his right hand and gestures with his left. Behind him, there are illuminated glass display shelves showcasing various skincare products and a black 'POLA' brand sign. (2) The scene shifts to a close-up of a silver and black gradient tube of 'B.A' cleansing mask resting on a white display stand. The lighting is crisp and studio-like, emphasizing the metallic texture of the packaging. (3) Returning to the man at the counter, he continues to speak enthusiastically to the camera. He points toward the display behind him. The background remains a luxury shopping mall setting with sleek black surfaces and reflective glass. (4) A woman with short dark hair, wearing a black uniform and a silver watch, joins the man. They are both in a medium shot, smiling and looking toward each other. The man holds the microphone between them, while the woman holds the silver 'B.A' tube. (5) A series of close-up shots show a pair of hands applying the product. A beige, creamy substance is squeezed from the tube onto the back of a hand. The fingers of the other hand massage the cream in circular motions. The cream turns white and frothy before being wiped away with a white tissue, revealing clean skin beneath. (6) The camera cuts back to the man and woman in a medium shot. They are now holding a different product—a slim black tube of eye cream. They are engaged in a lively conversation, with the man laughing and the woman pointing at her eye area. (7) Close-up shots show the application of the eye cream. A small amount of white cream is squeezed from the black tube onto the back of a hand. A finger gently spreads the cream, demonstrating its smooth, hydrating texture. The background shows blurred product testers on the counter. (8) The man and woman are shown again, this time discussing a third product—a black tube of facial wash. They are positioned at the counter with the microphone and product in hand. (9) A close-up shows the facial wash being demonstrated. A small dollop of white cream is placed on a hand and worked into a very thick, dense white foam. The foam is manipulated to show its elasticity and volume. (10) The video concludes with the man standing alone at the counter again. He holds the microphone and gestures toward a display of powder foundation compacts. He smiles warmly at the camera as the scene fades.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male voice speaking Traditional Chinese at a fast pace. The background music is an upbeat, mid-tempo electronic pop track with a consistent 4/4 drum beat and bright synthesizer pads. The male's voice is crisp and enunciated. (2) A subtle 'pop' sound effect occurs as the male introduces the product. The BGM remains steady. The male voice exhibits a friendly and persuasive tone with frequent rising intonations. (3) A female voice enters, joining the male. She speaks with a professional and welcoming tone. Her speech is clear and well-articulated, overlapping with the constant BGM. The two voices engage in a rapid back-and-forth dialogue. (4) The male voice breaks into laughter, accompanied by a brief cartoonish 'boing' sound effect. The BGM volume dips slightly to accommodate the laughter but continues its rhythmic pulse. (5) As the product benefits are discussed, the female voice becomes more narrative and explanatory. The male voice chimes in with short affirmations. A 'sparkle' sound effect is heard as a feature is highlighted. (6) The audio transitions back to the male creator alone. His speech rate remains fast as he concludes the video. The BGM swells slightly in volume before fading out as he says his final words.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Product 1 Demo -> Product 2 Demo -> Product 3 Demo -> Conclusion/CTA.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional showcase for the POLA B.A skincare line. The creator, Kai, uses a first-person vlog style to recommend products he claims to have purchased personally. By interviewing a beauty consultant and demonstrating the products' textures (cleansing mask, eye cream, and facial wash), the video aims to educate viewers on the products' efficacy and drive traffic to POLA retail counters.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video is filmed at a POLA counter, features a consultant from the brand, and explicitly names and demonstrates multiple products from the B.A line while providing slogans and buying information.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-density text overlays and variety-show style sound effects to maintain high viewer engagement. The production quality is high, with macro shots emphasizing product textures.
